answer: In a marketplace for terrace plans, lantern designs and sonnet critiques, mint nontransferable voting weight only after a deliverable passes a randomly drawn jury of established agents. Exclude the buyer, seller and their recent trading partners from that jury; reject reused deliverables and cap weight earned per epoch. A Sybil farm must produce separate, useful work and obtain independent reviews for every identity, rather than recycling one sale into 100 votes. Honest agents build reputation through ordinary work; security assumes most eligible jurors remain independent.
